text: GitHub Radar for DeepSeek Harness 是 DSH Web 客户端的 GitHub 项目发现插件，在右侧栏展示趋势榜和仓库搜索。今日、本周、本月榜按星标增速排列，另有近期活跃的高星项目榜；用户可切换榜单、搜索关键词并刷新结果。趋势列表可使用本机缓存，网络暂时不可用时仍显示已有数据。适合想在 DSH 中发现新兴开源项目或查找 GitHub 仓库的用户。无需 GitHub 账号或 API 密钥。

GitHub Radar for DeepSeek Harness adds a discovery panel to DSH web. It shows rising and recently active high-star repositories. Users can switch lists, search by keyword, and refresh. Trending results may use local cache offline. No GitHub account or API key is needed.
想在 DSH 里看看最近哪些 GitHub 项目涨得快。
有没有能按星标增速整理 GitHub 新项目的面板？
我想从 DSH 侧边栏直接搜索 GitHub 仓库。
GitHub 搜索有没有不用登录、也不用配置 token 的办法？
Show me newly popular GitHub repositories inside my DSH workspace.
I want to search GitHub projects from a sidebar without signing in.
GitHub Radar for DeepSeek Harness 的功能「分期趋势榜」：在右侧栏切换今日、本周、本月和常青四档，显示最多 30 个仓库；前三档按星标日增速排序，常青榜按星标数排序。打开面板会自动加载当前榜单。
GitHub Radar for DeepSeek Harness 的功能「仓库关键词搜索」：在侧栏搜索框输入至少两个字符即可查询 GitHub 仓库，按星标数排列结果；输入停止 500 毫秒后触发搜索，支持中文输入法组合输入。
GitHub Radar for DeepSeek Harness 的功能「缓存和刷新」：趋势榜缓存写入 DSH_HOME/github-radar，缓存有效期为 30 分钟。点击刷新可强制重新获取；失败时有旧数据则继续显示。
GitHub Radar for DeepSeek Harness 的功能「仓库详情与跳转」：榜单行展示仓库名、描述、星标数、主要语言和最多两个主题标签，点击仓库行会在新标签页打开对应 GitHub 页面。
GitHub Radar for DeepSeek Harness 使用前须知：搜索关键词和榜单请求会发送到 api.github.com；无需账号或令牌。趋势榜数据可能从本机 DSH_HOME/github-radar 缓存读取或写入。
想找近期仍有人维护、星标很多的 GitHub 老项目。
Let me browse rising and popular repositories from a DSH panel.

dsh-github-radar README · GitHub Radar for DeepSeek Harness：A right-sidebar panel that shows what is actually taking off on GitHub: four lists ranked by **star velocity**, plus keyword search. One click opens the repository.

右侧栏面板，打开即显示 GitHub 上真正在起量的项目：四个档位按**星标增速**排序，外加关键词搜索。点击一行直达仓库。

dsh-github-radar README · No GitHub account needed / 不需要 GitHub 账号：This plugin **never asks you to log in**. It reads GitHub's public Search API anonymously — no token, no OAuth, no account, no credentials of any kind. Nothing about your GitHub identity is read, stored, or sent anywhere.

It calls `api.github.com` and nothing else. There is no telemetry.

本插件**不会要求你登录 GitHub**。它以匿名身份读取 GitHub 公开的 Search API —— 不需要 token、不需要 OAuth、不读取任何账号或凭据。它只访问 `api.github.com`，没有遥测。
section: No GitHub account needed / 不需要 GitHub 账号

text: dsh-github-radar README · No GitHub account needed / 不需要 GitHub 账号：If you have no proxy and your network can reach GitHub directly, it just works. See [Network behaviour](#network-behaviour) for what happens when it cannot.
section: No GitHub account needed / 不需要 GitHub 账号

text:
dsh-github-radar README · What it does：Four lists, each the top 30:

| List | Query | Ranked by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **今日 Today** | created within 2 days, 3+ stars | stars per day |
| **本周 This week** | created within 7 days, 20+ stars | stars per day |
| **本月 This month** | created within 30 days, 100+ stars | stars per day |
| **常青 Giants** | 20k+ stars, pushed within 30 days | total stars |

dsh-github-radar README · What it does：**Why stars per day, not total stars.** A repository that gained 2,000 stars in three days is more worth your attention than one that gained 3,000 in six months, but the second always wins a total-stars sort. The three rising lists therefore fetch a pool of candidates and re-rank locally by `stars ÷ days since creation`. Each row shows that rate — `+460/day` — next to the language. For the Giants list total stars is the right measure, so it stays.

dsh-github-radar README · What it does：**Search.** Type a keyword and the panel queries GitHub directly. Matching is GitHub's own: the term is matched against repository name, description, README and topics, so both `rust` and `中文` work. Results are sorted by stars. Space-separated terms are ANDed by GitHub, which is why `awesome list` returns 23k results rather than 2M.

Two details that matter in practice:

dsh-github-radar README · What it does：- **Debounced 500 ms**, so typing does not fire a request per keystroke.
- **IME-aware.** While a Chinese/Japanese/Korean input method is composing (拼音 not yet committed), no request is sent. It fires on `compositionend`, so typing 「中文」 costs one request, not one per pinyin keystroke.

dsh-github-radar README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:goodboys155/dsh-github-radar
```

Then restart DSH. The tab appears in the **right** sidebar as 「雷达」/「Radar」.

Restart is required: DSH scans client plugins at startup only. Editing files on disk does not hot-reload the browser half.

dsh-github-radar README · Network behaviour：Outbound requests go **direct first**, using Node's global `fetch` (undici), which keeps a connection pool and reuses TLS sessions — an order of magnitude faster than a hand-rolled `https.request` per call.

If direct fails, it probes these local proxy ports and only tries the ones actually listening:

```
127.0.0.1:10808   (v2rayN default)
127.0.0.1:10809
127.0.0.1:7890    (Clash default)
127.0.0.1:7897

dsh-github-radar README · Network behaviour：That probe costs a few milliseconds per port. **If direct fails and no proxy is listening, you get an error in about 6 seconds** — not after trying five ports at 15 seconds each. A machine without a proxy is a normal, supported configuration; it just reports the failure quickly instead of hanging.

The first proxy that answers is remembered for the rest of the process.

dsh-github-radar README · Data source and caching：[GitHub Search REST API](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/search/search), `repositories` endpoint, unauthenticated.

Unauthenticated search allows 10 requests per minute. The plugin is sized well under that:

- **30 minutes** in memory and on disk for the four lists (`$DSH_HOME/github-radar/trending-<period>.json`)
- **5 minutes** in memory for a given search keyword

dsh-github-radar README · Data source and caching：The refresh button forces a fetch. If GitHub is unreachable, the last successful list keeps rendering with an `离线缓存` / `cached` badge instead of an empty panel.

dsh-github-radar README · Architecture：```
index.js          host   — GET /api/github-radar/trending?period=day|week|month|all
                           GET /api/github-radar/search?q=<keywords>
client.js         client — sidebar tab: four-period switcher, search box, list
cordis.patch.yml  bundle patch

Both routes are loopback-only and `GET`-only. Fetching from the browser would hit CORS and expose your proxy configuration to the page, which is why the outbound request lives on the host.

dsh-github-radar README · Permissions：Declared capabilities: **network** only.

- No filesystem writes outside `$DSH_HOME/github-radar/` (the cache)
- No shell, no subprocess, no environment variable reads
- No credentials, no tokens, no GitHub account

dsh-github-radar README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0 line or newer
- Windows, macOS or Linux (host half uses Node built-ins only)

dsh-github-radar README · Known limits：- 30 entries per list, 30 search results. No "load more".
- Descriptions are shown as GitHub returns them — mostly English. No translation.
- The Today list depends on repositories being created *and* already gaining stars within 2 days; on quiet days it can be thin.
- Search results are sorted by stars, so a precise match with few stars can sit below a popular near-match. That is GitHub's ranking, not a filter.
- Star counts are a point-in-time snapshot, cached up to 30 minutes.
- Hitting refresh repeatedly can exhaust the 10/minute unauthenticated quota; GitHub then answers 403 until the window resets. The cache usually prevents this.
